title: LLM-Based Exogenous World Modeling for Dynamic Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2610.29308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic scheduling requires dispatching online arrivals while anticipating future jobs, as poor decisions can compound downstream costs under nonlinear tardiness objectives. We show that a pretrained large language model (LLM) can serve as the exogenous component of a structured world model, forecasting uncertain future job arrivals. Specifically, we exploit an afterstate decomposition, which separates known deterministic shop transitions from uncertain exogenous job arrivals, enabling the LLM to forecast only the latter through a compact belief representation. Building on this, we develop Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP), which combines an evolved, belief-conditioned dispatching strategy with short scenario-based rollouts. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的外生世界建模用于动态调度
translated_abstract: 动态调度需要在处理在线到达任务的同时预判未来作业，因为在非线性拖期目标下，糟糕的决策会使下游成本不断累积。我们证明，预训练的大语言模型（LLM）可以作为结构化世界模型的外生组件，用于预测不确定的未来作业到达。具体而言，我们利用一种后状态分解方法，将已知的确定性车间状态转移与不确定的外生作业到达分离开来，使LLM仅需通过紧凑的信念表示来预测后者。在此基础上，我们提出了后状态世界模型规划（AWMP）方法，该方法将演化得到的、以信念为条件的调度策略与基于场景的短时前瞻推演相结合。一种由“意外”触发的刷新机制仅在新观测到的作业到达与先前预测产生足够大的偏差时才查询LLM，而在线残差自校准机制则进一步让LLM以其最近的预测残差为条件进行修正。
tldr: 该论文提出将预训练大语言模型作为结构化世界模型的外生组件，通过后状态分解与紧凑信念表示预测未来作业到达，并结合信念条件化调度策略、意外触发刷新机制和在线残差自校准，实现了高效的动态调度规划。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes using a pretrained LLM as the exogenous component of a structured world model for dynamic scheduling, leveraging afterstate decomposition and compact belief representations to forecast future job arrivals, combined with belief-conditioned dispatching, surprise-triggered refresh, and online residual self-calibration.
